subject.title: feat(config): add canonical group-policy scope-tree resolver

question: Should the public `ScopeTree` tool-policy resolver require verified channel/provider identity whenever it evaluates `toolsBySender`?
rationale: Channel-scoped sender keys are an authorization boundary, and an optional provider can silently select a less-specific policy while the new plugin SDK contract becomes permanent.

options.title: Require provider identity
options.body: Make channel/provider identity mandatory for sender-policy evaluation and update migration callers and parity tests accordingly.

options.title: Fail closed when omitted
options.body: Allow omission only when channel-scoped sender policies produce an explicit failure or no result instead of falling through to generic policy.

options.title: Defer the public export
options.body: Keep the resolver internal until a dependent channel migration proves the final API and security semantics.

recommendation.title: Require provider identity
recommendation.body: Make channel/provider identity mandatory for sender-policy evaluation and update migration callers and parity tests accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: They reworked and merged the existing channel-scoped sender-policy contract and are the strongest history-backed owner for this boundary decision.
